title: Sum Every Line
statement:
Add up every number in the input, however many lines there are.

The input is zero or more lines. Each line holds one integer or is blank. There is no count line, so keep reading until the input ends, and skip the blank lines. Print the sum of all the integers, or `0` when the input has none.

Input:

```text
3
10
-4
```

Expected output:

```text
9
```
hints: You do not know how many lines are coming, so loop until reading another line fails or the input runs out.
Turn each line into a number before you add it, and leave out lines with nothing on them.
